notes: SEC URLs are accepted as URL inputs and downloaded by docling-graph before conversion.
Remote LLM presets require the relevant provider API key.
Local LLM presets require the local model server, such as Ollama or vLLM.

pipeline_config_fields.description: Path to the source document
pipeline_config_fields.name: source

pipeline_config_fields.description: Pydantic template class or dotted path string
pipeline_config_fields.name: template

pipeline_config_fields.description: Custom LLM client instance to use for LLM backend.
pipeline_config_fields.name: llm_client

pipeline_config_fields.description: Runtime overrides for LLM settings.
pipeline_config_fields.name: llm_overrides

pipeline_config_fields.description: Enable schema-enforced structured output for LLM extraction.
pipeline_config_fields.name: structured_output

pipeline_config_fields.description: Enable sparse structured-output quality check with automatic legacy fallback.
pipeline_config_fields.name: structured_sparse_check

pipeline_config_fields.description: Enable chunking for document processing
pipeline_config_fields.name: use_chunking

pipeline_config_fields.description: Max tokens per chunk when chunking is used (default: 512).
pipeline_config_fields.name: chunk_max_tokens

pipeline_config_fields.description: Max total input tokens per LLM batch in delta extraction.
pipeline_config_fields.name: llm_batch_token_size

pipeline_config_fields.description: Enable debug artifacts (controlled by --debug flag)
pipeline_config_fields.name: debug

pipeline_config_fields.description: Preset: 'standard' for typical LLMs; 'advanced' for larger context (more paths per ID-pass call, larger fill batches).
pipeline_config_fields.name: staged_tuning_preset

pipeline_config_fields.description: Retries per staged pass when LLM returns invalid JSON (None = use preset).
pipeline_config_fields.name: staged_pass_retries

pipeline_config_fields.description: Parallel workers for extraction (staged fill pass and delta batch calls). None = use preset for staged.
pipeline_config_fields.name: parallel_workers

pipeline_config_fields.description: Drop/repair delta IR nodes with unknown catalog paths.
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_normalizer_validate_paths

pipeline_config_fields.description: Canonicalize delta IR identifier values before merge.
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_normalizer_canonicalize_ids

pipeline_config_fields.description: Drop nested properties from delta IR nodes/relationships.
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_normalizer_strip_nested_properties

pipeline_config_fields.description: Attach batch/chunk provenance to normalized delta IR.
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_normalizer_attach_provenance

pipeline_config_fields.description: Enable optional post-merge delta duplicate resolvers.
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_resolvers_enabled

pipeline_config_fields.description: Resolver mode for delta post-merge dedup.
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_resolvers_mode

pipeline_config_fields.description: Similarity threshold for fuzzy post-merge dedup.
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_resolver_fuzzy_threshold

pipeline_config_fields.description: Similarity threshold for semantic post-merge dedup.
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_resolver_semantic_threshold

pipeline_config_fields.description: Optional list of property names used for resolver matching.
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_resolver_properties

pipeline_config_fields.description: Optional path allowlist for resolver matching.
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_resolver_paths

pipeline_config_fields.description: If True, allow resolver to merge nodes with different non-empty ids (content similarity decides). If False, do not merge when both have distinct identity strings.
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_resolver_allow_merge_different_ids

pipeline_config_fields.description: Maximum allowed unknown-path drops before delta quality gate fails (-1 disables).
pipeline_config_fields.name: quality_max_unknown_path_drops

pipeline_config_fields.description: Maximum allowed ID key mismatches before delta quality gate fails (-1 disables).
pipeline_config_fields.name: quality_max_id_mismatch

pipeline_config_fields.description: Maximum allowed nested property drops before delta quality gate fails (-1 disables).
pipeline_config_fields.name: quality_max_nested_property_drops

pipeline_config_fields.description: Require root instance in delta quality gate.
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_quality_require_root

pipeline_config_fields.description: Minimum attached nodes required by delta quality gate; below this, fall back to direct extraction.
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_quality_min_instances

pipeline_config_fields.description: Maximum allowed parent lookup misses before delta quality gate fails. Use -1 to disable this check (e.g. for deep or id-sparse schemas).
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_quality_max_parent_lookup_miss

pipeline_config_fields.description: Enable adaptive parent_lookup_miss tolerance for delta quality gate.
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_quality_adaptive_parent_lookup

pipeline_config_fields.description: Minimum non-empty merged node properties required by delta quality gate (-1 disables).
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_quality_min_non_empty_properties

pipeline_config_fields.description: Minimum non-empty scalar root fields required by delta quality gate (-1 disables).
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_quality_min_root_non_empty_fields

pipeline_config_fields.description: Optional minimum non-empty property counts per catalog path for delta quality gate (e.g. {'line_items[]': 3}).
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_quality_min_non_empty_by_path

pipeline_config_fields.description: Maximum allowed orphan ratio before delta quality gate fails (-1 disables).
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_quality_max_orphan_ratio

pipeline_config_fields.description: Maximum allowed duplicate canonical identities across paths before delta quality gate fails (-1 disables).
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_quality_max_canonical_duplicates

pipeline_config_fields.description: Maximum split-retry rounds for failed delta batches.
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_batch_split_max_retries

pipeline_config_fields.description: Drop entity nodes whose identity value is not in schema allowlist or looks like a section title.
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_identity_filter_enabled

pipeline_config_fields.description: If True, drop any entity node whose identity is not in allowlist; if False, also drop when section-title heuristic matches.
pipeline_config_fields.name: delta_identity_filter_strict

pipeline_config_fields.description: Run optional second-pass extraction (what did you miss?) for direct and delta contracts.
pipeline_config_fields.name: gleaning_enabled

pipeline_config_fields.description: Max gleaning passes (1 = one extra pass). Used when gleaning_enabled is True.
pipeline_config_fields.name: gleaning_max_passes

pipeline_config_fields.description: Max nodes per LLM call in fill pass (None = use preset).
pipeline_config_fields.name: staged_nodes_fill_cap

pipeline_config_fields.description: Paths per ID-pass call; 0 = single call (None = use preset).
pipeline_config_fields.name: staged_id_shard_size

pipeline_config_fields.description: Discover only identity-bearing paths in ID pass.
pipeline_config_fields.name: staged_id_identity_only

pipeline_config_fields.description: Use compact ID-pass prompt to reduce token pressure.
pipeline_config_fields.name: staged_id_compact_prompt

pipeline_config_fields.description: Auto-shard ID pass when catalog paths exceed this threshold.
pipeline_config_fields.name: staged_id_auto_shard_threshold

pipeline_config_fields.description: Minimum split size when retrying failed ID shards.
pipeline_config_fields.name: staged_id_shard_min_size

pipeline_config_fields.description: Require root descriptor in staged quality gate.
pipeline_config_fields.name: staged_quality_require_root

pipeline_config_fields.description: Minimum ID instances required by staged quality gate.
pipeline_config_fields.name: staged_quality_min_instances

pipeline_config_fields.description: Maximum allowed parent lookup misses before fallback.
pipeline_config_fields.name: staged_quality_max_parent_lookup_miss

pipeline_config_fields.description: Max tokens for staged ID pass responses. Default 16384 avoids truncation on large catalogs; set to None to use client default.
pipeline_config_fields.name: staged_id_max_tokens

pipeline_config_fields.description: Optional max_tokens override for staged fill calls.
pipeline_config_fields.name: staged_fill_max_tokens

pipeline_config_fields.description: Control file exports to disk. None (default) = auto-detect: CLI mode exports, API mode doesn't. True = force exports. False = disable exports.
pipeline_config_fields.name: dump_to_disk
